name: Iimori (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iimori town emblem in black and red: a black stylised device of two curved strokes crossed by a red elliptical ring.
history: Flag of the former town of Iimori in Nagasaki Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1965.

features.role: Iimori town emblem — a black stylised device of two curved strokes crossed by a red elliptical ring
